Guides for cleaning, documenting and revisiting older code and data.

```{=html}
<script>
(function () {
  var label = document.createElement("p");
  label.className = "guide-count";
  label.setAttribute("role", "status");
  function update() {
    var items = document.querySelectorAll(".quarto-listing .list > *");
    var n = 0;
    items.forEach(function (i) { if (i.offsetParent !== null) n++; });
    label.textContent = n + (n === 1 ? " guide" : " guides");
  }
  window.addEventListener("load", function () {
    var chips = document.querySelector(".quarto-listing-category");
    if (chips) { chips.appendChild(label); var all = chips.querySelector(".category"); if (all) all.classList.add("active"); }
    update();
    document.addEventListener("click", function () { setTimeout(update, 100); });
  });
})();
</script>
```
